t.en: In <level-ref to="dist"></level-ref> this sentence took several boxes on the proof board. This time, reason back from the goal.
t.zh: <level-ref to="dist"></level-ref>里，这句话在证明板上用了好几个框。这一次，从目标往回推。

after.en: A row of parts like this is a proof script, one part to a line.
after.zh: 这样一串元件就是一段证明脚本，每个元件一行。

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.
brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。

hint.en: First take apart every given that comes apart.
Then split into two cases, and in each choose a side of the “or”.
hint.zh: 再分两种情况，每种情况各选「或者」的一边。
